description: This file defines Vulkan API wrapper classes and structures for managing physical devices, logical devices (Adapter), queues, and related resources within the ATen native Vulkan backend of PyTorch. It includes class definitions for PhysicalDevice, DeviceHandle, and Adapter, along with associated methods for resource management, queue handling, and device properties.

classes.name: PhysicalDevice
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan physical device with properties and metadata.

classes.name: DeviceHandle
classes.description: Manages a Vulkan logical device handle with resource management semantics.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan logical device (adapter) with queue management, resource caches, and device properties.

methods.name: DeviceHandle
methods.description: Constructor and destructor managing VkDevice handle.

methods.name: Adapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing Vulkan adapter with device and queue setup.

methods.name: request_queue
methods.description: Requests a compute queue from the adapter.

methods.name: return_queue
methods.description: Returns a previously requested queue to the adapter.

methods.name: submit_cmd
methods.description: Submits a command buffer to a queue with optional fence.

methods.name: submit_cmds
methods.description: Submits multiple command buffers to a queue with optional fence.

methods.name: stringize
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Adapter.
